# Feature: Timed orb — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #15 (Timed orb) from Orbs before it is used in real levels. Effect: vanishes if not reached in 10 seconds. Unique: the orb itself has the deadline, not the level. Useful: forces target priority inside a calm level. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** vanishes if not reached in 10 seconds.

**So that** forces target priority inside a calm level.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Timed orb for the first time in its teaching room (mech-15-timed-orb-room). Teaching moment: First room: two orbs, one of which starts its ring when it scrolls into view. A player who collects the nearer orb first watches the timed orb dissolve and reform, losing nothing but the trip, which teaches that the ring begins on sight and sets the order for them. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: The countdown starts the first time the orb enters the camera view, with a ring showing the seconds left
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Collected in time it counts as normal
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: If it expires it dissolves and reforms at its start tile after 5 seconds, so the level is never unwinnable

## Edge Cases & Rules

- If it expires it dissolves and reforms at its start tile after 5 seconds, so the level is never unwinnable
- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Timed orb's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-15-timed-orb-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/orbs.yml mechanic #15.
